author: Jake Durant
title: Hematite championship reception held at Ishpeming High School - NewsBreak
text:
By Jake Durant ,
1 days ago
ISHPEMING (WBUP/WJMN) - After taking home their second state championship in three seasons this past weekend, the Ishpeming girls basketball team was back on their home floor Tuesday for a title celebration.
Hematite faithful showed out for their hometown squad, as team members were given a chance to take the mic and reflect on the toughness and perseverance they showed on their run to the state title. They became the U.P.'s only program to take home a championship trophy this season.
The Hematites become the 14th U.P. girls basketball team to win an MHSAA state title, and are just the third program to win multiple titles, joining St. Ignace and Carney-Nadeau.
